title: Counting a country
caption: Storage medium: cardboard.
footnote: Please do not fold, spindle or mutilate the exhibit.

nodes.label: Census schedules
nodes.detail: Paper forms filled in door to door.

nodes.label: Blank cards
nodes.detail: Card stock cut to fit the punch and the reader.

nodes.label: Hollerith tabulating system
nodes.detail: Counts people by reading holes in cards with electricity.

nodes.label: Pantograph punch
nodes.detail: A clerk turns one person's answers into holes in one card.

nodes.label: Card reader
nodes.detail:
Pins drop through the holes into cups of mercury.
Each one closes a circuit.

nodes.label: Dial counters
nodes.detail: Each closed circuit moves a dial forward by one.

nodes.label: Sorting box
nodes.detail:
A lid pops open.
The clerk drops the card in by hand.

nodes.label: House seats
nodes.detail: Congress divides seats among the states by population.

nodes.label: Newspapers
nodes.detail: Print the totals for everyone else.

edges.label: Written answers
edges.detail: Each person's answers are copied onto one card.

edges.label: What to count
edges.detail: The office names the totals it needs.

edges.label: Blank cards
edges.detail: One card per person: about 63 million.

edges.label: State totals
edges.detail: Population by state decides each state's seats.

edges.label: Finished tables
edges.detail: Clerks copy the dial readings into tables for print.

edges.label: Released figures
edges.detail: Papers print the totals as they come out.

edges.label: Punched cards
edges.detail: Fed in by hand, one at a time.

edges.label: Electric pulses
edges.detail: One pulse for each hole read.

edges.label: Which lid
edges.detail: The circuit picks the lid that opens.

edges.label: Second pass
edges.detail: Sorted piles go through again for finer counts.

plan.label: Punch the cards
plan.detail: Copy every person on the schedules onto a card.

plan.label: Count the holes
plan.detail: Feed the cards through. The dials add up.

plan.label: Sort and recount
plan.detail: Regroup the cards to count combinations, such as age by state.

plan.label: Publish the totals
plan.detail: Copy the dial readings into tables and send them to print.
